shortDescription: Manage a virtual function of a partition (DPM mode)

options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: cpc_name
options.description: The name of the CPC with the partition containing the virtual function.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the target virtual function that is managed. If the virtual function needs to be created, this value becomes its name.

options.name: partition_name
options.description: The name of the partition containing the virtual function.

options.name: properties
options.description: Dictionary with input properties for the virtual function, for O(state=present). Key is the property name with underscores instead of hyphens, and value is the property value in YAML syntax. Integer properties may also be provided as decimal strings. Will be ignored for O(state=absent). options.name: state
options.description: The desired state for the virtual function. All states are fully idempotent within the limits of the properties that can be changed: * V(absent): Ensures that the virtual function does not exist in the specified partition. * V(present): Ensures that the virtual function exists in the specified partition and has the specified properties.
